Assumption or boundary: Supplied quote data and bar-level opening/touch conventions; no queue or partial entry-fill model.
Strategy-clock expiry, cancellation, explicit horizons and recorded nonfill outcomes.
Declared phase and quantity conventions; intrabar ambiguities remain possible.
State availability and one-shot instructions must be distinguished; no universal exchange calendar.
Notional helper supplied; ATR risk budgets, return-volatility sizing, and multiplier/rounding choices belong to the recipe.
Quote-based fills reflect supplied spread; the general cost model is theoretical. Commissions, impact, funding and additional slippage are not deducted.
Realised P&L by default; optional external equity curve. No automatic mark-to-market account.
Reporting capital and entry-admission flags do not enforce solvency, margin or financing.
Declared windows, finite grid and objective; independent runs and explicit execution boundaries.
No automatic Kelly sizing or general equity-dependent risk controller is supplied.
No consolidated multi-currency ledger, live broker interface or claimed deployment platform.
Progressive examples and inspection interfaces; no measured superiority or learning-outcome claim.
